question: Yajur Veda deals with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The **rituals of the Yagna.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Yajur Veda contains the rituals of the Yagna.
 
• The *Yajur Veda* is an ancient collection of Sanskrit **verses and mantras**, used in Hindu rituals and worship. 
 
• It is one of the four primary scriptures of Hinduism known as the Vedas - ***Rig Veda**, Yajur Veda, **Atharva Veda* and *Sama Veda*****. **
 
• The name is derived from the Sanskrit roots -** *****yajus***, meaning** ****"sacrifice" **or **"worship"** and ***veda***, meaning **"knowledge"**, Yajur Veda can be translated as **"Knowledge of the Sacrifice".**
 
• The Yajur Veda is divided into two parts - the "pure" or white Yajur Veda known as ***Shukla***, and the "dark" or black Yajur Veda known as ***Krishna***. The Shukla deals with prayers and specific instructions for devotional sacrifices, whereas the Krishna deals with sacrificial rituals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sama Veda **deals with melodies. 

 
 
• ​It is a collection of melodies and chants, and is also called the **"Book of Song", "Veda of Chants" **or **"Yoga of Song."** 
 
• It should not be read or recited, but sung.
 
 
 
• The **Atharva Veda** contains magic spells. 
 
 
• ​It is a collection of **20 books **containing chants, hymns, spells and prayers; and involves issues such as healing of illnesses, black magic, prolonging life, and rituals for removing maladies and anxieties.
 
 
 
• The** Rig Veda** is the Veda of mantra. 
 
 
• It is organized into **10 books**, called ***mandalas***. 
 
• It is the oldest of the Vedas, and one of the oldest extant texts in any Indo-European language.
